name: Fado & Traditional Music: Sandra Cristina
description: Experience the soul of Portugal at the iconic Casa da Música as Fado singer Sandra Cristina takes the stage for an evening of powerful and emotive traditional music.
longDescription:
On August 28, 2026, Casa da Música hosts an evening dedicated to Fado and traditional Portuguese music, featuring singer Sandra Cristina. This performance showcases the genre of Fado, a musical expression recognized for its melancholic melodies and poignant lyrics, often reflecting themes of longing, destiny, and the sea. Sandra Cristina is known for her interpretations of classic Fado repertoire, bringing her vocal style to the traditional arrangements.

Attendees can expect a concert setting within the distinctive architecture of Casa da Música, a venue celebrated for its acoustic design. The performance will offer a focused presentation of Portuguese musical heritage, delivered in the Portuguese language. The atmosphere is typically one of attentive listening, suitable for those interested in cultural performances and traditional music. The duration of the event will align with standard concert lengths.

This is a ticketed event. Information regarding ticket purchase and availability will be provided closer to the date. Casa da Música is located in the Boavista area of Porto and is accessible via public transport, including the Carolina Michaelis metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F) which is a short walk away, and various bus routes. The venue offers facilities for accessibility.
